info.name: HerNext MVP Backend (Pre-Deployment QA)
info.description: Executable QA suite for the HerNext (Team FiveFold) backend, generated from the verified route inventory and docs/API_CONTRACT.md. Two execution modes: (A) Fast regression via seeded demo accounts (no OTP) - run folders 00, 02, then 05-13; (B) Deep fresh-account gate (manual OTP) - run folder 01 to register+verify a brand-new account, then 03, 05-13. Replace {{testEmailDomain}} with a mailbox you can actually read. See docs/POSTMAN_TESTING.md.

item.name: 15 - Rate Limiting (opt-in, use LAST)
item.description: Opt-in probes that intentionally trip rate limits. Run the whole collection first, then run only this folder. WARNING: GET /ai/roadmap will be throttle-limited for ~60s for the caller IP, and the register probe burns 21 register permits for ~15min. These are destructive to parallel runs - run last and alone.
